free_tier.stated: 50 GB asset storage + 50 GB asset bandwidth on Starter — but Starter is $35/month, NOT free

egress.terms: 50 GB/month asset bandwidth included on Starter ($35/mo). Self-hosted Strapi has no storage cap but he pays the compute.

tooling: Strapi REST + GraphQL, upload plugin → any S3-compatible provider, `strapi` CLI; self-host is MIT-licensed
chaining: No free tier on Cloud at all — the cheapest plan is $35/project/month. The free path is self-hosting Strapi on free compute (Oracle/AWS free tier) pointed at another storage backend, which is orchestration, not a free storage tier.
limits_note: Paid-only. 50 GB storage / 50 GB bandwidth at $35/mo; unlimited DB entries.

evidence.proved: 'Starter $35 per project / month ... 100k API requests | 50 GB asset storage | 50 GB asset bandwidth' (no $0 tier listed)
